title: Director of Quality Assurance
text:
**Location**
: Walsenburg, CO
 
 
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Director of Quality Assurance to lead and oversee quality management initiatives across manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality management systems to ensure products meet industry standards for safety, compliance, and quality.
 
 
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in manufacturing quality assurance, regulatory compliance, quality audits, and continuous improvement methodologies, including Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance policies, procedures, and standards aligned with industry best practices.
 
 
Lead and coordinate internal and external quality audits to ensure compliance with regulatory and legal requirements.
 
 
Oversee quality control activities, including inspections, testing, and analysis of manufacturing processes and products.
 
 
Implement and monitor quality management systems using Six Sigma, Lean Management, and GDT (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) methodologies.
 
 
Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, regulatory affairs, and supply chain teams to address quality-related issues.
 
 
Conduct root cause analysis of non-conformities and product deviations, and lead Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
 
 
Ensure compliance with FDA regulations, GMP standards, ISO certifications, and other applicable manufacturing requirements.
 
 
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve operational efficiency, and maintain product integrity.
 
 
**Required Experience & Qualifications**
Proven experience in a senior quality assurance or quality management role within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
 
 
Extensive knowledge of FDA regulations, GMP practices, ISO certifications, and related regulatory requirements.
 
 
Experience implementing quality systems using Six Sigma manufacturing principles, Lean Management techniques, and GAMP (Good Automated Manufacturing Practice).
 
 
Strong background in quality audits, inspections, testing, and quality analysis.
 
 
Leadership experience managing cross-functional teams with strong communication and collaboration skills.
 
 
Familiarity with QA/QC processes, project management methodologies, and regulatory documentation practices.
 
 
**Benefits**
Dental Insurance
 
 
Health Insurance
 
 
Life Insurance
 
 
Paid Time Off
 
 
Relocation Assistance
 
 
Retirement Plan
 
 
Vision Insurance
